newsitem.title: USA: BE Semiconductor Industries NV Q3 net.
newsitem.headline: BE Semiconductor Industries NV Q3 net.

text.p: (Netherlands guilders in thousands, except per share data)
NOTE: Q3 earnings per share in U.S. dollars: $0.15 VS proforma $0.11.
NOTE: (1) 1995 periods represent BESI's results of operations which include Meco's results of operations for the five months ended Sept. 30, 1995.

(2) Pro forma results reflect the acquisition of Meco as if such transaction had occurred on Jan. 1, 1995 and eliminate a $44.4 million charge from the write-off of acquired in-process research and development costs, reflect additional depreciation and amortization acquired assets, reflect the tax effects related to such adjustments and eliminate a one-time non-cash management compensation charge and interest expense relating to a loan repaid from the company's initial public offering proceeds.
(3) Net income per share is calculated by dividing (pro forma) net income by the total number of outstanding ordinary shares and ordinary share equivalents.
